messages:
maya: quick review  compact drilldown header v3. two main asks: make correlation id obvious to screen readers, and de-emphasize export so users don't click it by accident.

ari: agree. proposal: corr-id left-most, small icon + pill; quick-actions popover (copy/permalink/share) adjacent; move Download to kebab/overflow.

jordan: accessibility checklist: popover trigger needs aria-expanded + aria-controls; items as buttons; copy action should announce `Copied correlation ID <id>` via an aria-live polite element. avoid generic `Copied`.

sam: tab order currently header -> download -> corr -> details. change to header -> corr -> quick-actions -> kebab -> details. small DOM change fixes SR order.

lee: contrast note: corr pill ratio 2.9:1 vs white. need 4.5:1 for text. options: darker bg (#1f2a38) or 1px dark border + bolder text. also ensure touch targets >=44px.

a11y-bot: scan result: corr-pill contrast 2.93:1; recommended AA color or 2px focus outline. also flag: tooltip must appear on focus, not just hover.

maya: microcopy: change `Export trace` -> `Download trace (JSON)` when in kebab. add filename pattern `trace-<corrid>-<iso>.json`. telemetry: fire `trace.export` with corr_id + export_size.

ari: action items: (1) move download to kebab, (2) implement quick-actions popover for copy/permalink/share, (3) reorder DOM so corr-id precedes actions, (4) bump pill contrast + focus-visible, (5) add aria-live copy feedback and tooltip-on-focus. i'll post updated comps here later today.

maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
